contract.input: Optional Idempotency-Key, validated by core.idempotency: 1..255 printable ASCII chars. Existing route has no business body parameters.
contract.fingerprint: {sid,did}; namespace = current workspace + caller lineage/client identity + POST + route template + key
contract.success: 202 existing delivery_public response; keyed repeat returns original accepted response bytes and Idempotent-Replayed: true. GET delivery remains the source for current status.
contract.conflict: Changed sid/did in same key namespace returns 409 idempotency_conflict only after current cached-result access validation; resource id is error.details.resource_id.
contract.ttl: Existing core.idempotency TTL retained (default 24 hours). Pause/7-day event eligibility is not re-applied to a still-cached accepted receipt; after cache TTL, new-work rules apply.
contract.replay_access: Reauthenticate raw machine credential under the Store writer; cached delivery id resolves its actual current subscription. Require the same current admin/history permission and tenant as GET delivery; deleted subscription/result or revoked/narrowed credentials refuse. Ignore changed request sid for cached-result access checks.
contract.atomicity: New delivery and idempotency claim/response commit or roll back in one Store transaction; response persistence failure leaves neither. Dispatcher.notify runs only after outermost commit and never on replay or rollback.
contract.unkeyed: Each request continues to create a new delivery subject to existing active-subscription and 7-day window checks, now inside write transaction.
contract.console: Only optional JSON field idempotency_key:string. Shared validation restricts it to POST exact Docs redeliver path; no arbitrary header/URL. Replayed header returned as headers['idempotent-replayed']. Field absent calls adapter with original five positional arguments.
contract.console_presentation: After awaited Docs dispatch, recheck current machine authority and actual result id/409 conflict resource id under a transaction before returning data. Existing browser authority recheck retained.
contract.secret_routes: Create subscription and rotate-secret still reject Idempotency-Key with 400 idempotency_not_supported; no secret cached.
contract.openapi: Redeliver decorator now uses _ox('admin', idempotent=True); generated contract files untouched for parent export.

Cached response or conflict metadata could be authorized against a new request path instead of actual stored result
Console awaited response could outlive subscription deletion or credential authority
